activity_context.topic_title: Calculating the Eigenvalues of a 2x2 Matrix

feedback.problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 \\ 2 & 3\end{aligned}].$
feedback.worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $A-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
A-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}5-\lambda  & 0 \\ 2 & 3-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(A-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}5-\lambda  & 0 \\ 2 & 3-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (5-\lambda )(3-\lambda )-0\cdot 2 & =0 \\ (\lambda -5)(\lambda -3) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =5$ and $\lambda =3.$

**Note:** The eigenvalues of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix are the entries on the main diagonal.
